style_instructions: An experienced operator is talking with one smart peer across a table, working through a real puzzle—not presenting or reading copy. Speak the text exactly as written: add, omit, repeat, or paraphrase nothing. Begin as if the conversation is already underway. Keep the first sentence matter-of-fact, not headline-like. In both uses of "missing," keep the word light and connected to its phrase. Underplay "Or worse" with dry recognition; let "Everything is green" be briefly deadpan; let the opportunity emerge with quiet curiosity, not a dramatic lift. Keep phrases connected. Use small, irregular changes in pace and brief pauses only when the thought changes, never as a repeated cadence. Energy seven of ten. Natural American conversation, grounded and lightly informal. Emphasize ideas, not individual words. Never sound like an announcer, trailer, podcast host, stage pitch, or motivational speaker. Pronounce "2022" as "twenty twenty-two." Do not vocalize these directions.
